answers.tour: A short tour of the main features.
answers.modelTest: Open a test, answer the parts, track your progress.
answers.textNote: Rich text notes that you can format and link.
answers.colorNote: Small post-its that float on the page.
answers.vocab: Your own word list with translations and examples.
answers.highlight: Mark text, listen to it, or save it as a word.
answers.ai: Translate words and generate example sentences.

open.title: 📝 Open a model test
open.text: Click a model test card to open it. The ring on the card shows how much you've already done.

parts.title: Answer the parts
parts.text: Each test has the exam parts (Lesen, Hören, Schreiben, Sprechen). Answer, then check your results. Your answers are saved to your account.

timer.title: ⏱ Practise under exam time
timer.text: Start the timer to simulate real exam conditions.

open.title: 🗒️ Open your notes
open.text: Click Notes to open your notes panel.

add.title: Create a text note
add.text: Click “Text note” to add a new note at the top of the list.

write.title: Write and format
write.text: Type in the note and use the toolbar for bold, lists and colors. Changes save automatically; the Save button saves right away and shows ✓ once the server confirmed it.

link.title: 🔗 Link related notes
link.text: Use the link button on a note to connect it to another text note, so you can jump between them.

open.title: 🟨 Open your notes
open.text: Click Notes to open your notes panel.

add.title: Create a color note
add.text: Click “Color note” to add a small post-it.

use.title: Move it anywhere
use.text: The note floats over the page. Drag it by its top bar to place it. While it saves, a small spinner turns in its top-right corner, then a ✓ appears.

useMobile.title: Swipe through your notes
useMobile.text: On the phone, color notes live on a card board: open it from the notes panel and swipe between your notes.

open.title: 📚 Open your vocabulary
open.text: Click Vocabulary to open your word list.

new.title: Add a word
new.text: Click “+ New” to open the form for a new word.

form.title: Fill in the word
form.text: Type the German word and its translation (or press AI to translate it). You can add an example sentence too, then save.

import.title: 📥 Import and export
import.text: At the bottom you can export your list to Excel or import words from an .xlsx file (columns Wort | Übersetzung | Kontext).

signIn.title: 👤 Sign in to save words
signIn.text: Your words are saved to your account, so sign in or create a free account first.

open.title: 🖍️ Open an exercise
open.text: Open a model test and go to a reading or listening text.

select.title: Select or right-click text
select.text: Select a word or sentence in the exercise (or right-click it). A small toolbar appears next to it.

selectMobile.title: Select text
selectMobile.text: Press and hold on a word, then adjust the selection. A small toolbar appears next to it.

tools.title: Use the toolbar
tools.text: Pick a color to highlight, listen to the text, translate it, or save it straight to your vocabulary. Highlighting needs the Silver plan or higher.

open.title: ✨ Open the AI settings
open.text: Click AI. The dot turns green once your AI key is set up.

key.title: Add your free Gemini key
key.text: Follow the steps in the AI window to create a free Gemini key and paste it. It's stored only on this device.

use.title: Use AI in your vocabulary
use.text: In the vocabulary form, press AI to translate a word or to generate an example sentence (example sentences need the Gold plan).

language.title: 🌍 Change the language
language.text: Choose the language of the app here.

theme.title: 🎨 Change the theme
theme.text: Pick colors and a background that you like.
